speaker: Doctor
text:
Dr. Agent: I understand you are experiencing sudden vertigo. To help narrow this down, have you noticed any new neurological symptoms like double vision, slurred speech, or weakness? Also, has your hearing been affected in either ear?

REQUEST TEST: Hearing_Audiometry
REQUEST IMAGES: MRI_Brain

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Audiometry Findings: Within normal limits for age. Head Imaging Findings: Normal, with no evidence of stroke or masses.

speaker: Doctor
text: Good news so far; the hearing test is normal and the MRI rules out stroke or tumors. Since your vertigo is sudden, has this episode been triggered by specific head movements, and have you felt any nausea or vomiting?

speaker: Patient
text: 59-year-old male. The patient presents to the emergency department with a sudden-onset sensation that the room is spinning, leading to several episodes of nausea and vomiting. The symptoms started as he was going to bed and lasted for approximately 3 minutes. He mentions that he has never experienced anything like this before and currently feels at his baseline.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Given the normal neuroimaging and the brief duration of your spinning sensation, this sounds less like a stroke and more like a peripheral issue. Did you notice that the spinning specifically started or worsened when you turned your head in bed, and do you currently have any lingering ear fullness or ringing?

REQUEST TEST: Dix-Hallpike_Manöver

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Dix-Hallpike Manoeuvre Findings: Positive, inducing nystagmus and reproducing patient's symptoms of vertigo when head is turned to the left and laid back.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV)

Based on the positive Dix-Hallpike test reproducing vertigo and nystagmus with a specific head position, your diagnosis is BPPV. This condition is caused by displaced calcium crystals in your inner ear. I will now prescribe the Epley maneuver to reposition these crystals and resolve your symptoms.
